name: Ruthless Opportunist (Combat)
body:
You are quick to take advantage of opponents who have been injured in melee, surprising them with your ruthless attacks.

Prerequisite(s): Opportunist advanced rogue talent

Benefit: When you use the opportunist talent to make an attack of opportunity, your target is denied its dexterity bonus to AC against the attack.
